information_flow: The premise-boundary call receives the six common inputs and emits only a binding account of rejected assumptions and the forbidden inherited mechanism. The final constructor consumes that account and all common inputs, retaining direct anchor and contract visibility while independently emitting one policy without authority to restore the rejected lineage.
name: Negative-Authority Premise Cut with Direct-Visibility Constructor

calls.objective: Identify the inherited structural assumptions that constrain independent reasoning, establish one binding prohibition against their repair lineage, and provide causal obligations for an independent construction without proposing or materializing a policy.

Use the predecessor's binding exclusions together with direct common-input visibility to reason at whole-policy scope, preserve contract validity, and emit exactly one complete policy without reinstating the forbidden inherited mechanism.
